name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-10-04, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.17 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
